_comment: Project-scoped registration. PreToolUse ONLY: the user-global bridge (~/.grok/hooks/hq-hq-bridge.json, installed by `hq reindex`) is the reliable path and carries ALL lifecycle events. Passive/side-effect events (SessionStart, PostToolUse, Stop, PreCompact, SessionEnd, SubagentStop, Notification, UserPromptSubmit) are registered on the bridge ONLY so they never double-run when a Grok build loads both this project file and the bridge. PreToolUse is intentionally on BOTH: blocking is idempotent, so redundant enforcement is safe and desirable.
